Citymaker.Recipe.ZenGarden.Description: Raked gravel, rock groupings, a pond with bridges, lanterns and stepping stones.
Citymaker.Zen.Name: Zen garden
Citymaker.Zen.style.Tooltip: Dry rock garden, pond stroll garden, tea garden, moss garden or bamboo grove.
Citymaker.Zen.gravel.Tooltip: Share of the inner garden given to the raked gravel field (0 = none).
Citymaker.Zen.pond.Tooltip: A pond in the inner garden with bridges and islands. Digging it is permanent.
Citymaker.Zen.fieldShape.Tooltip: A crisp rectangle (temple garden) or a soft organic outline.
Citymaker.Zen.raking.Tooltip: Raked patterns painted into the gravel: straight lines, ripples around the rocks, or both.
Citymaker.Zen.gravelLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the gravel field gets (permanent paint).
Citymaker.Zen.rakeLayer.Tooltip: Texture (1–4) of the raked strokes; pick one that contrasts with the gravel.
Citymaker.Zen.gravelSurface.Tooltip: Lay a gravel or sand surface instead of painting the terrain (no raking then).
Citymaker.Zen.rockGroups.Tooltip: Number of rock groupings — always odd, never symmetric.
Citymaker.Zen.groupSize.Tooltip: Stones in each group: threes, fives, or the classic mixed 5-3-3-1-3 rhythm.
Citymaker.Zen.mossRings.Tooltip: Moss painted under the rock groups in the gravel.
Citymaker.Zen.pondSize.Tooltip: Share of the area the pond aims for.
Citymaker.Zen.bridgeStyle.Tooltip: Zig-zag plank bridges (yatsuhashi) or straight crossings.
Citymaker.Zen.islands.Tooltip: Crane and turtle islands, each with a pine.
Citymaker.Zen.steppingStones.Tooltip: Stepping-stone trails through the moss and to the tea house.
Citymaker.Zen.prunedTrees.Tooltip: Specimen pines, maples and cherries per hectare.
Citymaker.Zen.shrubs.Tooltip: Clipped shrub mounds per hectare, set in groups of three or five.
Citymaker.Zen.bamboo.Tooltip: A bamboo screen along the outline, or a whole bamboo grove.
Citymaker.Zen.mossPaint.Tooltip: Paints the inner garden with a terrain texture (permanent).
Citymaker.Zen.lanterns.Tooltip: Lanterns at bridge ends, entrances, the shore and the rock groups.
Citymaker.Zen.teaHouse.Tooltip: A tea house on the quietest spot, with a waiting bench, basin and stepping stones.
Citymaker.Zen.basin.Tooltip: A stone water basin (tsukubai) with a lantern beside it.
Citymaker.Zen.wall.Tooltip: A wall or fence around the garden, open at the entrances.
Citymaker.Zen.Issue.PondPermanent: The pond is dug into the terrain and filled with water. This is permanent: removing the garden does not restore the ground.
Citymaker.Zen.Issue.NoField: The gravel field did not fit in the inner garden. Lower the gravel share or enlarge the area.
Citymaker.Zen.Issue.NoPond: No room for the pond inside the stroll loop.
Citymaker.Zen.Issue.NoTeaHouse: No quiet spot was large enough for the tea house.
Citymaker.Zen.Issue.FewerGroups: Only {0} of {1} rock groups found a place.
Citymaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.Name: Tea house
Citymaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.bench.Tooltip: A bench on the way in, where guests wait to be called.
Citymaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.basin.Tooltip: A stone basin by the entrance for washing hands.
Citymaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.stones.Tooltip: Stepping stones from the nearest path to the door.
